references.text: Jacob named the place Bethel, but the city was formerly called Luz. This is the original naming of the city mentioned in Judges 1:23.
Jacob came to Luz in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel. This confirms that Luz was the former name of Bethel.
Jacob mentions that God revealed himself to him in Luz in the land of Canaan, which is Bethel.
Luz is mentioned as a border city for the tribe of Joseph, showing the connection with the house of Joseph who spied out the city.
The boundary goes down to Luz, that is, Bethel. This again confirms the identification of Luz with Bethel.
Spies were sent out to explore the land, similar to how the house of Joseph sent spies to Bethel.
